name: proxy-for-codex
description: Configure future Codex launches from normal Windows entry points to use a proxy without stopping or restarting running processes.

interface.shortDescription: Use a proxy from normal Codex launches
interface.longDescription: Configure independent HTTP and HTTPS proxies for future ChatGPT/Codex launches from normal Windows entry points. Persistent user environment variables apply the proxy after one full restart without creating a separate shortcut. The plugin never stops, terminates, or restarts Codex.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Proxy for Codex is configured and ready.
Configure this proxy so normal Codex launches will use it after I restart.
Launch Codex with the configured proxy without restarting an existing instance.
